summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phases 1-4 (Foundation + Auth + Landing + Dashboard + Plan Wizard + Plan Workspace). Backend APIs are 100% functional (17/17 tests passed). Frontend has critical issues with plan wizard session management and plan data synchronization that block the core user journey.

critical_bugs.issue: Session loss during wizard flow - user is redirected to /login after filling slide 2 (title field)
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS plan creation flow entirely. Users cannot complete the 5-slide wizard.
critical_bugs.evidence: API call to /api/plans failed with net::ERR_ABORTED. After filling title on slide 2 and clicking Continue, page redirected to /login instead of proceeding to slide 3.

critical_bugs.issue: Plans created via backend API do not appear in frontend dashboard
critical_bugs.impact: HIGH - Users cannot see their plans even though they exist in the database. Backend test created a plan for alice.iif.test@example.com successfully, but dashboard shows empty state.
critical_bugs.evidence: Backend test created plan ID 234fc7d5-9ff4-4a09-bdf4-fe2a2cd7bb6c for alice. Frontend dashboard shows 'Welcome, alice.iif.test. Begin your first plan' with no plans listed.

ui_bugs.issue: Full Name field not properly filled by automated test - HTML5 validation blocked submission
ui_bugs.impact: MEDIUM - Signup form has required Full Name field that wasn't detected by test script using input[type='text'] selector. Should use data-testid='signup-name-input' instead.
ui_bugs.note: This is a test script issue, not an app bug. The form works correctly with manual testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button not found in user menu during automated test
ui_bugs.impact: LOW - User menu opened successfully but logout button was not detected. May be a selector issue or the button is not rendered.
ui_bugs.note: Needs manual verification - user menu opened but logout button not found by script

integration_issues.issue: Disconnect between backend plan creation and frontend plan listing
integration_issues.symptoms: Backend successfully creates plans and returns 201. Frontend GET /api/plans returns empty array or doesn't fetch plans correctly.
